answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 26077 Country: India Title: Is wearing of stones like neelam pukhraj etc for men is allow in islam or not ? Question: is wearing of stones like neelam pukhraj etc for men is allow in islam or not ??? Answer ID: 26077 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1770/1401/B=1431) The ring of stones other than agate and jasper (aqiq and yashb) is not lawful for males. However, one can set any kind of gem inside silver ring. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
